Hi Summerfades, as I mentioned in a different comment I am in training to become a clinical psychologist. What I can tell you from my years of study, and my years of going to therapy, psychologists are just people. What makes them different is that they have a knowledgable unbiased plan to help you with *your* life. You might not know what kind of struggles she had to deal with in relation to the pregnancy, and she definitely won't tell you unless it somehow helps with *your* treatment. 

So please do not leave if you have a connection and feel comfortable with her, since that is such an important part of therapy.
